cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor nexthop maddress" "for i in \$(seq 64); do echo x > /dev/udp/198.51.100.\$i/9; done; ip nexthop replace id 10 group 1,3/2,1 type resilient buckets 4 idle_timer 60 unbalanced_timer 1" "id 10 index [0-9]+ .*nhid 1"
desc: positive: a busy bucket forced to migrate by the unbalanced timer, RTM_NEWNEXTHOPBUCKET with NLM_F_REPLACE
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip addr add 192.0.2.1/24 dev c0 && ip nexthop add id 1 via 192.0.2.254 dev c0 && ip nexthop add id 2 via 192.0.2.253 dev c0 && ip nexthop add id 10 group 1/2 type resilient buckets 4 idle_timer 60 unbalanced_timer 1 && ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 nhid 10
